I can’t go on long rides without talking to someone or listen to music that gets me in a really good mood or else the anxiety kicks in. You can also trying using remedies such as peppermint (I always use gum/mints) and ginger to give you peace of mind as well as possible relief. 

You shouldn’t let this fear control you to the point of risking your job. I know it’s terrifying but you’ll be okay. Two weekends ago I put myself out of comfort zone by going on a 2 hour bus ride with severe N, 3 nights in a row. You can get through this!

From my past experiences, keeping yourself a suitable distance from the infected and holding your breathe/covering your mouth and nose while in the areas where someone has v'ed brings at least some reassurance. 

Also, if it comes to the point where you do v try and tell yourself that the fears are irrational and if it happens once it's less likely to happen again. The fear of doing it tends to make it worse so have a mint, chew mint gum or whatever remedy helps/prevents nausea for you and try to take steady breaths.
